text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The one who conquered the race was Kitasan 
Black.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yet, Satono Crown showed no haste. For the 
crown she ought to strive for was already 
clear in her sights.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next target is the Takarazuka Kinen. 
Fired up for a rematch against Duramente 
and Kitasan Black, preparations get 
underway—
